name: config-undocumented-env-var
title: Config drift — the worker reads a new signing-secret env var that neither .env.example nor the README lists

pullRequest.title: Sign every delivery
pullRequest.body: Subscribers can't tell our deliveries from anyone else's POSTs. Every delivery now carries an HMAC-SHA256 signature of its body in `x-notify-signature`, keyed by a secret the worker reads at boot.
pullRequest.author: j-okafor
